facts.text: Deborah and her neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community on the previous day.

evidence.quote: Yesterday, me and my neighbor ran a free gardening class for the community, it was awesome!

facts.text: Deborah expressed that gardening brings people together and allows her to share her love of plants.

evidence.quote: Gardening is really amazing. It brings us together in such a cool way. It was awesome to share my love of plants and help people take care of the world.

facts.text: Jolene and someone else tried a scuba diving lesson on Friday and found a dive spot they can explore together.

evidence.quote: We tried a scuba diving lesson last Friday and had an awesome time! We found a cool dive spot we can explore together.

facts.text: Deborah recently visited her mother's old house and sat on a bench, feeling her presence and her love.

evidence.quote: Last Sunday, I visited her old house and sat on a bench. It was a comforting experience, as if I could feel her presence guide me and remind me of her love.
